headlines.title: Trump says ‘we’re looking at’ firing Kimberly Guilfoyle, the U.S. ambassador to Greece
headlines.description: The president’s remarks come days after a Trump donor alleged Guilfoyle tried to get him to pay $100,000 to get rid of her credit card debt shortly before her confirmation hearing.

headlines.title: Rep. Ilhan Omar’s home searched by federal agents in criminal probe
headlines.description: The Democratic congresswoman from Minnesota called the search “the latest escalation” in Trump’s “campaign of political intimidation.”

headlines.title: Judge tears into Trump administration for felling trees on D.C. golf course the president wants to remake
headlines.description: “I’m furious,” U.S. District Judge Ana Reyes told a Justice Department lawyer. “I trusted you all not to do precisely what you have done.”

headlines.title: Trump faces ‘bipartisan pushback’ on diesel deal with Russia as he tries to lower prices
headlines.description: President Trump is “doubling down” on his diesel deal with President Putin in an attempt to lower fuel prices. NBC News senior white house correspondent Gabe Gutierrez, NBC senior national political reporter Sahil Kapur and former U.S. Ambassador to Ukraine, Bill Taylor join Meet the Press NOW to discuss the deal.

headlines.title: ‘I’m asking for proof of spine from him’: Talarico challenges Paxton to debate
headlines.description: Texas State Rep. James Talarico (D-Texas) is dismissing rumors around his recent multi-day absence from the campaign trail in his bid for U.S. Senate, saying he simply had the flu. NBC 5’s Phil Prazan joins Meet the Press NOW to speak about his interview with Talarico as he returns to campaigning and his renewed challenge to debate his opponent Texas Attorney General Ken Paxton (R).

headlines.title: Texas Republicans at odds over GOP Senate nominee Ken Paxton
headlines.description: Texas Republicans are at odds over GOP Senate nominee Ken Paxton, with recently leaked audio by Paxton saying ousted longtime Sen. John Cornyn is not in his corner. NBC News' Natasha Korecki reports on how Republicans are trying to solve the infighting and how Democratic nominee James Talarico addressed his absence from the campaign trail.

headlines.title: MAHA fractures deepen as some RFK Jr. followers turn into harsh critics
headlines.description: A scorecard from MAHA activists suggests the Trump administration has broken most of its promises to the movement. The “burn feels especially raw,” one prominent activist said.

headlines.title: Drive to Decision Day: Voters sound off on the economy, war and Washington
headlines.description: With the midterm elections almost here, NBC News’ Jonathan Allen wanted to find out if Americans are frustrated enough with President Trump and Republicans to vote Democrats into power in the House and Senate. So he hopped in a van and drove 1,800 miles from New Jersey to Nebraska to meet with voters in eight battleground districts.

headlines.title: As Trump pushes for data centers, voters in key midterm races say they don’t want them
headlines.description: An NBC News Decision Desk Poll found that 69% of respondents oppose building AI data centers in their areas, with 45% saying they “strongly oppose” the idea.

headlines.title: ‘Fed up with a war they didn't want’: Midwestern voters air frustrations impacting the midterms
headlines.description: Senior National Politics Reporter Jonathan Allen joins Meet the Press NOW to discuss his conversations with frustrated voters on the ground in Iowa and Ohio ahead of the midterms in his Drive to Decision Day series.

headlines.title: Trump ‘doesn’t have a plan’ on Iran: Voters in key Pennsylvania district upset with handling of war
headlines.description: NBC News Senior National Politics Reporter Jon Allen hits the road for his Drive to Decision Day series to talk to voters in several battleground congressional districts that could determine the control of Congress. Jon Allen starts his road trip in New Jersey’s 7th congressional district and Pennsylvania’s 7th and 8th congressional districts.

headlines.title: 'Dear Donald': Battleground district voters share their message to Trump
headlines.description: On his final day of the NBC News Drive to Decision Day series, NBC News senior national politics reporter Jon Allen joins Meet the Press NOW from Nebraska to recap his trip and hisvisit to the “blue dot” district.
